name: Build Pipeline & CI/CD Security
description: Security assessment of software build pipelines and CI/CD systems. Covers pipeline configuration review, secret management, build reproducibility, artifact integrity (signing, provenance), runner security, and supply chain attack vector identification in build systems.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to build pipeline security assessment

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands CI/CD pipeline architecture and common security risks
evidence: Can explain CI/CD pipeline stages and common platforms (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins)
Understands risks of secret exposure, poisoned pipelines, and compromised runners
Familiar with SLSA framework concepts

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Reviews pipeline configurations for basic security issues under supervision
evidence: Reviewed CI/CD configuration files for secret exposure and excessive permissions
Identified insecure use of third-party actions or pipeline plugins
Assessed runner isolation and network configuration
Work reviewed by authorized analyst

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently assesses build pipeline security for engagements
evidence: Independently assessed build pipeline security on 5+ engagements
Identifies poisoned pipeline execution (PPE) attack vectors
Reviews artifact signing and provenance (Sigstore, in-toto) implementations
Produces actionable findings mapped to SLSA v1.0 Build track levels
Passed proficiency assessment on pipeline security

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles complex pipeline architectures; demonstrates attack chains
evidence: Demonstrates end-to-end supply chain attacks through pipeline compromise
Assesses multi-stage pipelines with complex dependency chains
Reviews custom build systems and hermetic build configurations
Mentors others on pipeline security assessment methodology

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Authority on build pipeline security; develops methodology and tooling
evidence: Published research on CI/CD or build pipeline security
Developed the lab's pipeline security assessment methodology
Contributes to SLSA or supply chain security standards
Trains teams on build pipeline security assessment

assessment_methods.description: Assess a CI/CD pipeline configuration for security weaknesses and demonstrate an attack path
Review of pipeline security assessment findings from recent engagements

work_roles: OG-WRL-017 Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management
